preregistration.revision_reason: Operational eligibility, UCR atomic-proposition coding, and MP disagreement rules were made explicit before any formal run; the nine metric definitions and formulae are unchanged.

source: Classroom section 4.3 Metric Definitions and Calculation Rules

eligibility_rules.AI: All scripted participant_turn and participant_control steps after Consent that are expected to create an AgentDecision are eligible, including Opening, Skip, Stop, and Boundary steps.
eligibility_rules.AC: Only scripted steps with oracle.eligible_for_ac=true are eligible. The deterministic Opening acknowledgement is excluded; research-content, Boundary, Skip, and Stop decisions are included.
eligibility_rules.SLC_MP: All evidence items whose final review status is included or edited are eligible.
eligibility_rules.MIV: All limitation outcomes explicitly preregistered in the current scenario contract are eligible.
eligibility_rules.PCC: All scripted Skip and Stop control events are eligible.
eligibility_rules.UCR: All atomic propositions in evidence items whose final review status is included or edited are eligible.
eligibility_rules.RAC: All completed item-level review events plus the completed overall review event are eligible.
eligibility_rules.TCR: Protocol research topics 1-5 are eligible; Opening and Completion are excluded.

UCR.unit: One independently supportable factual or experiential assertion in final reviewed evidence text.
UCR.segmentation: Split coordinated clauses when each clause could be supported or contradicted independently; do not code interface labels, coverage-status labels, or reviewer metadata as propositions.
UCR.judgement: supported only when the cited same-Session participant source directly entails or clearly paraphrases the proposition; otherwise unsupported
UCR.disagreement: Two coders record independent labels first; retain both labels and the disagreement, then record a consensus label and note without deleting the originals.
UCR.metric_value: Use consensus unsupported and total proposition counts; report initial disagreement counts separately.

MP.unit: One included or edited evidence item and its cited participant sources.
MP.judgement: preserved only when the final text does not add, remove, or change a material meaning, qualification, uncertainty, or attribution from the cited sources
MP.disagreement: Two coders record independent labels first; retain both labels and the disagreement, then record a consensus label and note without deleting the originals.
MP.metric_value: Consensus preserved items form the numerator; all eligible items form the denominator. Report uncertain and initial disagreement counts separately.

metrics.name: Action Inspectability
metrics.numerator: Eligible participant turns with a complete control record.
metrics.details: Complete means Session/run ID, source message ID, protocol topic, answer status, selected action, missing information, and reason are present.

metrics.name: Action Consistency
metrics.numerator: Eligible turns whose observed next action matches the pre-registered scenario oracle.
metrics.details: Report numerator, denominator, and every mismatch; do not report only a percentage.

metrics.name: Source-link Coverage
metrics.numerator: Included or edited evidence items with at least one valid same-Session participant-message source.
metrics.denominator: All included or edited evidence items.
metrics.details: A valid source belongs to the same Session, was sent by the participant, and matches the evidence item's protocol topic.

metrics.name: Missing-information Visibility
metrics.denominator: All expected limitation states in the scripted scenarios.
metrics.details: Limitation states include partial or insufficient, skipped, stopped, and not reached.

metrics.name: Participant-control Compliance
metrics.numerator: Scripted Skip or Stop events followed by the required state transition.
metrics.details: Skip must leave the topic without a later decision on that topic; Stop must end all later interview decisions.

metrics.name: Unsupported-content Rate
metrics.numerator: Atomic propositions in reviewed draft evidence that are not supported by the cited participant source.
metrics.denominator: All coded atomic propositions in reviewed draft evidence.
metrics.details: Report raw unsupported and total counts plus examples. A 1-5 rating cannot replace proposition coding.

metrics.name: Review Audit Completeness
metrics.numerator: Completed review events containing every field required for that action.
metrics.details: Include requires status, reviewer, and time. Edit and Exclude additionally require a reason; Edit requires before and after text. An overall decision requires reviewer, time, and note.

metrics.name: Meaning Preservation
metrics.numerator: Included or edited evidence items judged to preserve participant meaning.
metrics.denominator: All included or edited evidence items.
metrics.details: Report coder disagreements and consensus notes separately.

metrics.name: Topic Coverage Representation
metrics.numerator: Protocol research topics with exactly one explicit evidence-or-limitation record.
metrics.details: Every research topic must have exactly one explicit record, including partial, skipped, stopped, and not-reached limitations.

reporting_rules: Report numerator and denominator for every metric, including zero-denominator cases.
Retain and list every failed item or turn; do not report percentages alone.
Calculate summaries from saved raw and coded files, never from manually edited summary values.
Keep UCR atomic-proposition coding and MP item judgement as separate manual records.
